state.askedText: The EU record covers a whole class (brexucabtagene autoleucel, ciltabtagene autoleucel, idecabtagene vicleucel, lisocabtagene maraleucel…). Do the other U.S. labels in that class say it? The Skeptic's independent check contradicts: FDA_POTENTIAL_SIGNAL_LISTS-NOTHING-FOUND: an FDA row for axicabtagene ciloleucel does mention it (Q3 2023: Post-treatment T-cell malignancy). Held partly on a search that found nothing: H1 eu class effect vs us product specific. Not finding a record does not show a reason: judge it open, or cite a record that shows it. H1 should be 'open' because the US product-specific claim rests only on searches that found nothing; a record demonstrating US regulatory practice (e.g., FDA guidance on class vs product labeling) is needed to support 'holds'.

items.section: 12 CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY > 12.2 Pharmacodynamics > SPL UNCLASSIFIED SECTION
items.text: Effect on Cardiac Repolarization The effect of vortioxetine 10 mg and 40 mg administered once daily on QTc interval was evaluated in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-, and active-controlled (moxifloxacin 400 mg), four-treatment-arm parallel study in 340 male subjects.
